parameters.content:
## STOP reply → Status=Paused (product control)

1. Gmail Trigger polls inbound replies (importable; credential **placeholders only**).
2. If subject/body contains **STOP** (word boundary, case-insensitive), parse **InvoiceID** from subject/body when present; otherwise match by **ClientEmail + Status=Open**.
3. Google Sheets: set **Status = Paused**, append `[timestamp] STOP received` to **Notes**.

**Why this cancels remaining stages:** the main workflow `Compute Stage` skips `Paid` and `Paused`, so flipping to Paused stops any remaining 0 / +3 / +7 sends.

Replace `REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID`. Attach Sheets + Gmail credentials by name — **no tokens in this JSON**.

Note: reading replies needs a broader Gmail scope than `gmail.send` (e.g. readonly). Prefer a **separate** credential from the chase sender.
